pr_body:
##### Summary
We are replacing some of our existing tests with ones based on the CMocka library.

The idea is to have separate tests for every individual piece of netdata in order to compile and run them fast enough when we are developing/debugging such a piece.

Closes #6890

##### Component Name
Unit tests
